title: ASCENDANT
tagline: Every death is a lesson. The clock keeps running.
howToPlay: WASD to move, mouse to look, SPACE to jump. Hold SPACE longer to jump higher — a tap is a short hop, a full hold clears just over two metres.
Hold SHIFT to sprint. Sprinting adds about 40% to your jump distance, so a gap you cannot make from a standstill often opens up with a run-up.

You keep coyote time (a fraction of a second of grace after leaving a ledge) and jump buffering (press early and it fires the instant you land). Trust them — they are there so a good input is never eaten.
Glowing rings are checkpoints. Touch one and every death after it returns you there, with the hazards reset to the same timing.
Hazards run on a fixed clock, not on luck. The gauntlet that killed you will present exactly the same pattern next attempt.
Ice removes your grip, conveyors move the floor, wind pushes you off the edge, and lava, lasers, spikes, saws and crushers all kill instantly.
R restarts the stage, T sends you back to your last checkpoint, TAB opens stage select, ESC pauses.
tips: Bright edge stripes mark every landable surface — if it does not have one, you cannot stand on it.
Watch a hazard through one full cycle before committing. Every one of them telegraphs before it kills.
On ice, stop steering before you want to stop moving.
Jump pads launch you to a fixed height. Add your own jump on the frame you touch the pad for a little extra.
The orbs are never on the main route. If a coin looks easy, you are on the wrong line.

credits.worlds: Four hand-authored worlds — Neon Dojo, Lava Foundry, Frozen Spire, Sky Temple — each with its own lighting, sky, materials and music bed
credits.art: Procedural PBR material library (albedo/roughness/metalness/normal generated at runtime), procedural skies, plus CC0 prop models from the ForgeFlow asset library (attribution in assets/props/CREDITS.txt)
credits.audio: Fully procedural Web Audio — five generative music beds and every sound effect synthesised at runtime, no sample files
credits.engine: Three.js r172, ES modules, no build step
